text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 998 September 16, 1976
WITHDRAWING THE TAX PRIVILEGES UNDER PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 875
WHEREAS, by virtue of Presidential Decree No. 875 establishing a commissary and PX system for the
Integrated National Police System, all purchases thru such system from local sources, manufacturers,
suppliers and producers of commodities are free from all taxes, duties and other charges prescribed for similar
commodities under existing revenue and other laws, ordinances and regulations;
WHEREAS, such tax concessions have posed difficulties in policing the distribution of such tax exempt
goods, and resulted in the outright loss of the much needed revenues of the government;
WHEREAS, on the proposition that giving direct financial aid to such select group is better than giving them
tax advantages over the others, the salaries of the members of the Integrated National Police had been recently
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in
me vested by the Constitution, do hereby decree and order that all tax privileges given the commissary and PX
system of the Integrated National Police under Presidential Decree No. 875 are hereby withdrawn effective
upon the promulgation of this Decree.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 16th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
